message.content:
**A‑minor blues scale**

| Interval | Semitone offset |
|----------|----------------|
| Root     | 0               |
| Flat Ⅲ   | +3              |
| Perfect IV| +5             |
| Augmented IV / Flattened V° | +8      |
| Perfect V | +10            |
| Major VI | +13            |

In other words, starting on **A**, play:
```
A – C – D – Eb – E – G
```

These six pitches form the “blues” sound when used over an A‑based harmony.  
(If you prefer the seven‑note version, add B♮—the natural 7th—to get A–C–D–Eb–E–G–B.)
